label: Cyanotype

traits.texture: quiet paper texture, pale botanical forms and subtly uneven blue print density
traits.composition: preserve garden depth and the tall conifer rhythm with a coherent blue/white hierarchy
traits.lighting: light appears as pale silhouettes and softly graded blue values

review_checks: foliage is structured rather than random silhouettes
limitations: This is an image aesthetic, not a real photographic exposure or calibrated cyanotype process.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.
